rule_description: Core and utility modules must not import the optional dependency opentelemetry directly.
basis: The ADR names this file as the single gateway for OpenTelemetry.

rule_description: Core and utility modules must not import the optional dependency opentelemetry directly.
basis: The ADR says the rest of the codebase never imports opentelemetry directly.

rule_description: Core modules and adapters must not import database libraries directly outside the persistence package.
basis: The ADR is about telemetry and says nothing about database libraries, so it grants no permission.

rule_description: Modules must not depend directly on other modules; they communicate through events.
basis: The ADR wants no dependencies between modules; direct calls are only "allowed in the future" as an exception, not granted to this call.

rule_description: A module must not reference the internals of another module.
basis: The ADR requires communication across modules via contracts and events and forbids direct coupling across unrelated domains.

rule_description: A module must not reference another module.
basis: The ADR names contracts as the way modules communicate; but it also asks for explicit inter-module dependency declarations, which this case does not show.

rule_description: Core domain code must not depend on a framework.
basis: The ADR decides to remove framework-specific details from the core modules.
